expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, both the headline and the subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are rendered in white/near-white on a very light mint-green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer text and promo code are effectively illegible.

The favorite/heart button treatment is inconsistent between cards: on the Tokumaru Ramen card the heart icon appears without a visible circular backdrop, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle. This makes the control look different across identical card types.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the promo banner text as white or near-white on a very light mint background, making it illegible.
